description: Your role What You'll Be Doing Senior Software Engineer What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Software Engineer within our Alpha division. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will build secure, resilient, and scalable software solutions that support business-critical financial services. Continuously identify opportunities to improve software quality, operational efficiency, engineering processes, and system performance. Communicate technical solutions and progress effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong experience developing applications using C# and modern .NET. Strong experience designing cloud-native applications using AWS and serverless architectures. Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architecture. Strong experience designing and developing event-driven applications using messaging and event streaming technologies such as Amazon EventBridge, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or similar. Experience designing and developing reusable backend services, RESTful APIs, and system integrations. Experience building workflow automation, business process orchestration, or event-driven business applications. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modelling and performance optimisation. Experience defining and maintaining cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, with practical experience of AWS CloudFormation. Good understanding of Kubernetes and modern cloud deployment environments. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and observability practices for production systems. Strong understanding of secure software development principles and cloud security best practices. Experience designing highly available, resilient, business-critical software systems. Ability to analyse complex business processes and design scalable software solutions that automate workflows and improve operational efficiency. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. Nice to Have Experience within financial services, payments, banking, or other regulated industries. description: We are looking for an experienced Scripting & Automation Engineer to lead the modernization of legacy backend scripts, automation workflows, and data pipelines. Pipeline & Workflow Updates: Reconfigure Windows Scheduled Tasks, CI/CD pipelines, and PowerShell build scripts to execute scripts and tools natively on local disk storage. End-to-End Delivery: Take ownership of migrating legacy scripts, automation flows, and backend tasks from initial network path analysis through local verification and production rollout. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of hands-on software development and automation experience with Perl and Python in a Windows environment. Strong knowledge of Windows file systems (NTFS), network pathing mechanics (UNC format vs. local paths), process execution, and environment variables. Create user-friendly screens for configuration, monitoring, alarms, events and diagnostics. Connect the web application with backend REST APIs and WebSocket services. Ensure the interface is responsive, reliable and easy to use. Node.js Web Backend Develop backend services using Node.js and TypeScript. Design and maintain REST APIs for the Angular web client. Support real-time communication using WebSockets and socket connections. Handle authentication, authorization, logging and error handling. Linux Deployment and Support Deploy and support Node.js services on Linux. Configure services so they start and recover automatically. Troubleshoot application, network, server and performance issues. Maintain secure settings, logs, certificates and deployment procedures. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree 6+ years experience in software development Preferred Qualifications Good knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and responsive design. Good experience with Node.js, REST APIs and WebSockets. Understanding of authentication, authorization and secure coding practices. Experience with Linux environments, command-line tools and service deployment. Experience with Git or SVN, Jira, Jenkins or similar development tools. Ability to write unit, integration and automated UI tests. Testing Responsibilities Create automated tests for frontend and backend features. Test APIs, WebSocket communication and socket connections. Support integration testing, product verification and code reviews. Technical Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with enterprise web applications. Experience building scalable, secure and maintainable software. Ability to work across frontend, backend, database, testing and deployment areas. Behavioural Competencies Takes ownership and delivers work on time. Communicates clearly with team members and stakeholders. Works well independently and as part of a team. Shows curiosity, accountability and willingness to learn. Security Responsibilities Follow secure coding practices. Protect credentials, tokens, keys and configuration secrets. Use secure communication methods such as HTTPS and TLS. Support security logging, auditing and vulnerability checks. Desirable Experience Experience with security, access-control, alarm or industrial-control systems. Experience with real-time event processing and dashboards. Knowledge of automated security and dependency-scanning tools. Architecture Responsibilities The developer will be responsible for maintaining clear boundaries between: Keep frontend, backend, real-time communication and deployment components well organized. Design software that is reliable, secure, scalable and easy to maintain. Document interfaces, protocols, deployment steps and system behavior clearly. The system should remain cohesive and maintainable, with only the independent modules required to provide reliability, security, scalability and clear separation of responsibilities. Personal Attributes Able to work effectively across frontend, backend, protocol and Linux environments. Strong attention to protocol accuracy, security and data integrity. Able to diagnose issues across the browser, application, network and operating-system layers. Focused on reliability, maintainability and predictable system behaviour. Comfortable working with real-time, high-volume security information. Able to translate complex technical functions into clear operator interfaces. Capable of working within an established architecture. Able to collaborate with embedded, mobile, test and product-development teams. Capable of documenting interfaces, protocols, deployment processes and system behaviour clearly. In this role, you will own the architecture and implementation of immersive conversational AI experiences end-to-end—from pixel-perfect, responsive frontends to the backend services and LLM integrations that power them. You will partner with product, design, and AI engineers across the globe to translate ambiguous requirements into production code, extending existing systems where it makes sense rather than rebuilding from scratch, and helping to raise the bar for engineering quality across the team. Comfort and experience architecting and building rich, full-screen web experiences from scratch, with a strong eye for UX, accessibility, and visual polish. Deep experience with at least one major modern frontend framework (React strongly preferred; Angular, Vue, or Svelte also valuable), including state management and component architecture. Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express (or comparable), including REST API design, authentication, streaming responses, and integration with third-party services. Demonstrated experience building real-time or streaming user interfaces (chat, dashboards, collaborative tools, or similar) and a solid grasp of conversational UX patterns. Proven ability to architect non-trivial features end-to-end with minimal supervision and make pragmatic technology choices under ambiguity. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, designers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and own delivery from concept to production

Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in software development. 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role, overseeing projects. Experience managing people or teams. Experience in full-stack web development. Experience with relational (SQL) or NoSQL databases, data modeling, and large-scale data warehousing technologies. Preferred qualifications: Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization. Experience in designing and implementing full-stack, enterprise-grade applications and distributed systems (e.g., microservices, containerization). Experience in managing and leading engineering teams and partnerships with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams. Experience in managing both individual contributors and other managers. Experience with full-stack development (e.g., Java, Python, Golang, JavaScript). About the job Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started - and as a manager, you guide the way. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers. Responsibilities Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching. Develop the mid-term technical goal and roadmap within the scope of your (often multiple) team(s). Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs. Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems. Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency). We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. So whether you want to be a part of developing innovative technology, campaigns, products or partnerships, your work here is a chance to accomplish things that matter. title: Software Engineer - Lab Automation
description: India - Hyderabad JOB ID: R-261503 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Nov. 16, 2026 CATEGORY: Research The Research & Automation Technologies (R&AT) group within Amgen’s Automation, Research Informatics, and AI (ARIA) organization is seeking a highly creative candidate for a Software Engineer position. This person will be responsible for the development and delivery of full-stack solutions that accelerate the discovery and development of Amgen’s life-saving therapeutics. These solutions will require integration with multiple systems across our informatic ecosystem, using a variety of existing and emerging technologies, including source code repository and automated build system management, AWS infrastructure management, device driver development, and data integration. This Software Engineer will play a key role in developing solutions that enable the evolution of our Research labs into highly automated, highly integrated next-generation facilities. Our goal is to develop transformative, automated systems that fundamentally change the way science is executed in our Research labs. To effectively communicate and collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders, an understanding of biology, chemistry and drug discovery is essential. Position Responsibilities Full ownership of projects, from client scientist interviews and requirements gathering, to system and functional specification, to development, testing, training, and support. Development of code using .NET (C#, WPF) and Python (desktop applications, web applications, AWS lambda functions, etc.) to: control lab automation instruments; take input from lab information management systems and transform it into automation system-specific instructions; data extraction, transformation, and loading from lab automation instruments to lab information management systems. Solutions will regularly require integration with our Benchling lab information management system via REST APIs, Mosaic compound inventory and management system using REST APIs and/or a direct Oracle database connection, and a variety of other informatic ecosystem services. Close communication and coordination with our engineers to ensure the output (CSV, XML, JSON) of the utilities developed will work with the lab automation systems that will consume them. Continuous outreach, collaboration, and communication with scientists across multiple research organizations and geographies to identify opportunities, ideate solutions, manage expectations, and deliver fit-for-purpose lab informatic systems and integrations. Identify emerging, transformative technologies and develop innovative solutions that improve existing processes or enable novel processes. Identify and establish best practices across the full spectrum of software development tasks, including DevOps, documentation, end-user training, delivery, and support. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science OR Associate's degree in Computer Science and 5 years of in-industry experience Preferred Qualifications Master's in Computer Science, data science, bioinformatics, or a relevant field. Experience in device driver development and hardware communication and control. Expertise with Microsoft development technologies (Visual Studio, .NET Core and .NET framework, C#, WPF), and Python. Experience with cloud-based technologies, in particular AWS. Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Oracle, NoSQL). Experience with DevOps. Demonstrated ability to work in teams to scale a process from a manual proof-of-concept to a fully automated, high-capacity, high-throughput unattended operation. Knowledge of a variety of therapeutic modalities. Monitoring technological developments in the field and evaluation of emerging trends and best practices. Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Demonstrated successful interpersonal relationships with peers and colleagues in other engineering and scientific disciplines. High level of self-motivation.

description: Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer - AWS to design, build, integrate, and support the AWS services that power customer-facing digital experiences across Agilent.com and the connected Agilent ecosystem. The engineer will play a key role in supporting the product data cache in AWS that powers product data services needed by Agilent.com experiences, ensuring product information is reliable, performant, scalable, secure, and available for customer-facing journeys. The engineer will also ensure that data, content, product, search, and customer experience services are reliable, scalable, secure, observable, and optimized for business-critical use cases. Strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless architectures, API development, data pipelines, Graph APIs, and graph database capabilities on AWS is essential. This role currently follows a hybrid work model. Work arrangements may evolve based on future business needs. What you’ll do: Work within a cross-functional POD to deliver AWS services that support customer-facing experiences across Agilent.com, AEM, PIM, Coveo Search, eCommerce, content discovery, and the connected digital ecosystem. Design, build, and support serverless AWS ETL services that extract, transform, enrich, normalize, and deliver product, content, search, and customer experience data to downstream platforms. Support and enhance the product data cache in AWS that powers product data services consumed by Agilent.com experiences, enabling fast, reliable, and scalable access to product information across customer-facing journeys. Build scalable AWS-based APIs and integration services that connect AEM, PIM, Coveo Search, commerce, analytics, and other digital platforms to support customer journeys and business outcomes. Develop event-driven and serverless solutions using AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, S3, Glue, DynamoDB, Aurora, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, and related services. Design and maintain data pipelines that support structured and unstructured data movement for product information, content metadata, search ingestion, customer experience personalization, and platform synchronization. Build and support database services on AWS, including relational, NoSQL, and graph-oriented data models needed to power digital experience, search, content, and product data use cases. Develop and integrate Graph APIs and graph database solutions on AWS to enable relationship-driven use cases across products, content, assets, customer journeys, recommendations, and search relevance. Configure and support CDN capabilities using Akamai, Wangsu, or similar platforms, including origin setup, cache behavior, caching rules, cache invalidation, routing, and performance optimization for customer-facing digital services. Partner with AEM, PIM, Coveo, commerce, data engineering, analytics, DevOps, security, and architecture teams to ensure AWS services are well integrated, secure, resilient, and production ready. Implement observability, monitoring, alerting, logging, performance tuning, and operational support patterns for mission-critical services that impact customer-facing digital experiences. Apply secure engineering practices including IAM controls, encryption, API security, secrets management, data access controls, least-privilege design, and compliance-aligned cloud patterns. Contribute to agile delivery, backlog refinement, technical design, estimation, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, release readiness, and continuous improvement within the POD. Continuously improve AWS platform patterns that enable faster delivery, better reliability, higher reuse, and measurable customer experience outcomes across Agilent’s digital channels. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 6+ years of relevant software engineering experience building cloud-native applications, APIs, data services, integration services, or enterprise digital platform capabilities. Strong hands-on experience designing and building AWS serverless solutions using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, Event Bridge, S3, Glue, DynamoDB, Aurora, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, and related AWS services. Experience building AWS ETL services and data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, enrichment, validation, orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, error handling, replay, and production support. Strong API development experience, including REST APIs, Graph APIs, API lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, throttling, error handling, versioning, and performance optimization. Hands-on experience with AWS database services and data modeling patterns across relational, NoSQL, and graph-oriented workloads. Experience with Graph API and graph database concepts on AWS, including relationship modeling, graph queries, connected data patterns, and graph-powered customer experience or search use cases. Experience integrating AWS services with digital experience platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Product Information Management (PIM), Coveo Search, eCommerce platforms, content platforms, or customer-facing web applications. Experience configuring and supporting CDN platforms such as Akamai, Wangsu, or similar services, including origin configuration, cache rules, TTLs, invalidation/purge processes, routing behavior, and caching strategies for customer-facing web applications and APIs. Experience designing, supporting, or integrating AWS-based product data cache capabilities or product data services that support customer-facing web, search, content, commerce, or digital experience platforms. Must have strong hands-on programming experience in either Node.js or Python for building APIs, ETL services, automation, backend services, and cloud-native AWS integrations. Solid understanding of event-driven architecture, microservices, asynchronous processing, message-based integration, serverless design patterns, data quality, and scalable cloud operations. Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, observability, logging, monitoring, performance tuning, incident response, and production support for cloud services. Strong understanding of security practices for cloud-native services, including IAM, secrets management, encryption, network controls, API security, data protection, and least-privilege access. Ability to translate platform needs from AEM, PIM, Coveo Search, commerce, data, and business stakeholders into reliable, scalable, and maintainable AWS services. Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical mindset, attention to detail, and ability to operate effectively in a product-oriented agile POD. Strong communication skills and a collaborative perspective across engineering, architecture, product management, platform operations, security, analytics, and business stakeholders. Ways to stand out: Ability to fully utilize agentic development techniques, including AI-assisted coding, automated test generation, code review support, documentation acceleration, and workflow automation, to improve engineering efficiency, delivery speed, and overall development quality. Deep AWS serverless implementation experience across Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, Glue, S3, DynamoDB, Aurora, CloudWatch, IAM, and production-grade observability patterns. Experience designing Graph API and graph database solutions on AWS, including connected data models that support search relevance, recommendations, content relationships, product relationships, and customer journey use cases. Experience building AWS ETL pipelines that support AEM, PIM, Coveo Search, eCommerce, product data, content metadata, entitlement data, and customer-facing digital experience platforms. Experience integrating cloud-native services into large-scale B2B eCommerce, customer community, product discovery, technical documentation, support, or enterprise self-service experiences. Hands-on experience optimizing CDN configurations for global web performance, origin protection, API caching, content delivery, cache hit ratios, and resilient customer-facing experiences. Experience with Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especially in hybrid or multi-cloud enterprise environments, is a plus. Additional Details This job has a full time weekly schedule. title: Performance Reporting Analyst
description: Job Summary The Performance Reporting Analyst is responsible for consolidated performance measurement and reporting across the global portfolio and the Investment Division's other asset clusters, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. The role owns the monthly and quarterly reporting cycle: collecting and validating data from custodians, fund administrators, and external managers; computing returns against benchmarks and targets; and producing the performance packs used by the Executive Director, the Investment Committee (IC), and family shareholders. The position applies AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring extraction, reconciliation, and report production, and serves as the single source of truth for portfolio performance data across the India-based investment team and the Jeddah-based family governance structure. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Produce the monthly and quarterly consolidated performance reports covering the global portfolio and designated clusters, from custody statements, administrator reports, and manager reporting. 2. Maintain the division's performance database: positions, transactions, cash flows, and valuations, reconciled monthly to custodian and administrator records. 3. Calculate time-weighted and money-weighted returns (TWR/IRR) at portfolio, cluster, asset-class, and manager level, with realised and unrealised components separately identified. 4. Maintain the benchmark framework and produce attribution analysis by asset class, manager, and currency, explaining performance versus benchmarks and the IC's targets. 5. Prepare the quarterly IC performance pack and shareholder reporting with the Executive Director, including commentary, exceptions, and data-quality notes. 6. Track management fees, performance fees, and costs against provider agreements, and report fee drag as part of net performance analysis. 7. Build and maintain AI-enabled reporting pipelines for recurring document extraction, data validation, and report assembly, keeping human review over all published figures. 8. Liaise with the finance department to align investment performance records with the SAP accounting entries. 9. Maintain organised digital archives of all performance records, methodologies, and published reports, ensuring auditability of every reported figure. QUALIFICATIONS Minimum Education Required • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or business administration. • Strong understanding of performance measurement: TWR and IRR methodologies, benchmarking, attribution, and composite reporting (GIPS awareness preferred). • Experience with custodian and fund administrator reporting and multi-asset data (public markets, funds, private assets). • Proficient in Excel and financial systems; experience with Addepar or similar portfolio platforms preferred; working knowledge of Power BI or Python an advantage. • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools for document processing and reporting automation, with disciplined verification. • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and ability to manage recurring deadlines. Professional Certifications Required • N\A. (CIPM or CFA progress preferred) Years of experience are required. • Minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience in performance measurement, investment reporting, or fund operations at a bank, asset manager, fund administrator, or family office.

description: About The Company Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that! We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building. Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. The Data team turns raw information into trusted insights and scalable infrastructure, helping every team – from Product and Operations to Finance – move faster and act smarter. S&P owns the numbers that steer the business: the P&L, planning and target-setting, performance scorecards, and investor reporting. This role sits across both teams, combining rigorous analytical thinking, deep business understanding, and strong technical skills to make sure our financial data is accurate, well understood, and ready to drive decisions. If you’re passionate about using data to shape the future of a high-growth fintech, you’ll feel right at home with us. About The Role We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our S&P team and help run the engine behind Aspire’s P&L. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our data lead on the monthly data close, reconciliations, and P&L build-out for new products and markets, while owning the data that feeds our scorecards, planning, and investor reporting. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys getting to the bottom of a number and wants to own core finance data processes as the business scales. Key Responsibilities As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be a key owner of the data behind our P&L and performance reporting. Your responsibilities will include: Run the Monthly Data Close: Prepare and run the monthly data close checklist, making sure P&L, revenue and gross profit data are complete and accurate before sign-off. Own Reconciliations: Run the monthly reconciliation between data and Financial Control; investigate breaks, trace them to root cause, and resolve or escalate. Maintain the P&L: Make routine fixes and additions to P&L logic (e.g. daily card accruals), keeping definitions consistent as products and pricing change. Build P&L for New Products and Markets: Build and test P&L line items for new products and markets, covering payments, cards, receiving, payouts and customer balances across currencies. Power Planning & Performance Reporting: Refresh internal scorecards, maintain cohort datasets, and run segment cuts and simulations in Databricks to support planning, target-setting and investor reporting. Support the Annual Audit: Prepare data and respond to auditor requests alongside the Financial Control team during the audit cycle. Be First Line for Data Requests: Handle ad hoc requests from product teams, from troubleshooting and data clean-ups to reclassifications and data fixes with Engineering. Help Modernise Our Data Stack: Contribute to our move to Databricks and the data build initiatives that follow. Automate with AI: Use AI tools such as Claude Code to automate recurring checks, reconciliations and reporting. About You Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in finance analytics, analytics engineering, or a similar data role. Strong SQL is a must: you can write, debug and optimise complex queries independently. Experience with Databricks is a plus. AI-native: comfortable using Claude Code and other AI tools in your day-to-day work. Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and hands-on reconciliation experience. Solid understanding of the P&L, revenue and gross profit, and how they are built from transactional data. Background in fintech, payments or financial services (e.g. cards, FX, payments, interest/yield) is a strong plus. High attention to detail and the persistence to trace a break back to its root cause. Clear written English and comfort working asynchronously with a team across time zones. An ownership mindset and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. description: DESCRIPTION Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. The AOP team is an integral part of this and strives to provide Data and Science Capabilities to fulfill all customer processes in the APAC, LATAM, IN and MENA Ops businesses. This BIE role sits at a rare intersection and has high growth prospects. On one side, you have cutting-edge ML/OR models making split-second cost saving decisions across Ops network. On the other, you have the analytical depth required to understand why those models succeed, where they fall short, and what needs to change. You won't just be observing these models from the outside, you'll own them along with the Scientists. Their performance, their enhancements, their evolution over time, that's your responsibility. When the model needs a new feature, a re-calibrated threshold, or a fundamentally different approach to a particular corridor or condition, you're the one driving that forward in partnership with the scientists who built it. In some instances you will also directly own these models. The technical challenges here are genuinely complex and rewarding. You'll work with large-scale, low-latency data flowing through real-time pipelines. You'll design automated reporting frameworks that need to be as robust as the system they monitor. You'll apply statistical rigor to evaluate model performance in production, design experiments to validate enhancements, and quantify impact in an environment where conditions shift daily. But beyond monitoring, you'll be the one identifying what's broken, proposing what to build next, and owning the analytical path from hypothesis to deployed improvement. This is a role without a single well-worn toolkit, you'll have the opportunity to continuously sharpen your skills across data engineering, statistical analysis, and model evaluation to keep pace with the problems in front of you. What makes this role particularly compelling is the combination of ownership and impact. The products you will work on drive millions in cost savings for Amazon Ops. You will also be involved in cutting-edge research. You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity. Many of the most important questions in this space haven't been cleanly articulated yet, they emerge from patterns in the data, from model behavior that doesn't match expectations, from edge cases that only surface under certain network conditions. You'll need strong statistical foundations, fluency in SQL and Python and AWS Services, and experience building scalable BI solutions. Your ability to move between deep technical analysis and clear stakeholder communication, and to own outcomes end-to-end rather than just deliver reports, is what will make you exceptional in this role. Key job responsibilities 1. Own End-to-End Analytics: Independently design and deliver complex analytical solutions for ML/OR science products, translating ambiguous business requirements into scalable, actionable insights. 2. Drive Science Model Performance: Develop frameworks to monitor model accuracy, operational effectiveness, and business impact. Identify performance gaps, investigate root causes, and drive improvements. 3. Lead Complex Deep Dives: Analyze large-scale operational datasets, identify trends and anomalies, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence product and science decisions. 4. Build Scalable BI Solutions: Design and develop robust data models, ETL pipelines, automated reporting systems, and self-service dashboards using SQL, Python, AWS, and BI tools. 5. Partner on ML/OR Enhancements: Collaborate with scientists to evaluate new features, optimize model thresholds, design experiments, and validate improvements. Directly own analytical or statistical models where appropriate. 6. Establish Measurement Frameworks: Define KPIs, apply statistical methodologies, and develop rigorous approaches to measure model effectiveness, incremental impact, and financial benefits. 7. Influence Cross-Functional Stakeholders: Work with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Science teams across geographies to align analytical priorities and drive adoption of data-driven solutions. 8. Drive Technical Excellence: Establish best practices for data quality, analytical accuracy, automation, and solution scalability while improving existing BI processes and frameworks. 9. Provide Technical Guidance: Mentor junior BIEs, review analytical approaches, share best practices, and contribute to raising the technical bar across the team. 10. Deliver Business Impact: Develop mechanisms to quantify and track cost savings, productivity improvements, and operational efficiency resulting from science products. We are responsible for creating core science capabilities to scale decision making across domains such as Truck Capacity Optimization, Short-term capacity planning, Network Abuse Detection, Impact analyses, Productivity improvement Models and so on. description: PCBA Planner Electronic Component & Production Planning DEPARTMENT Production Planning REPORTS TO Production Planning Manager EMPLOYMENT TYPE Full-Time LOCATION On-site, Manufacturing Facility, HYD Job Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented PCBA Planner to own end-to-end planning for printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) across a diverse product portfolio of 50+ board types, ranging from low-complexity, high-volume boards to high-complexity, low-volume boards. This role sits at the intersection of supply chain and production planning: it requires close coordination with Supply Chain / Procurement to secure the availability of electronic components, and detailed, SKU-level PCBA build planning that is tightly synchronized with the system-level and box-build (final assembly) production plan. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and organizational discipline with a practical understanding of electronics manufacturing, and is comfortable managing complexity and ambiguity across many concurrent programs. Key Responsibilities 1. Component Availability & Supply Chain Coordination Work closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Commodity Managers to track and confirm availability of electronic components (ICs, passives, connectors, modules, etc.) required for each PCBA build. Proactively identify component shortages, long lead-time items, allocation risks, and single-source exposure; escalate early with clear impact statements (which PCBAs, which builds, which dates are at risk). Translate PCBA build plans into time-phased component requirements (MRP/MPS logic) and reconcile against supplier commitments, purchase orders, and inventory on hand. Coordinate expedites, alternate/second-source parts, and substitutions with engineering and supply chain, ensuring BOM and approved-vendor-list (AVL) compliance. Maintain visibility of incoming material (ETA tracking) and proactively resequencing PCBA builds when shortages or delays occur, minimizing line stoppages. 2. PCBA Build Planning & Scheduling Develop and maintain detailed, SKU-level production plans and schedules for 50+ PCBA types, spanning high-volume/low-complexity boards and low-volume/high-complexity boards, balancing SMT line capacity, kitting readiness, and labor availability. Sequence and prioritize PCBA runs to maximize SMT/THT line efficiency minimizing changeovers, setup time, and stencil/feeder changes — while protecting on-time delivery. Convert system-level and box-build (final product) plans into the corresponding PCBA demand and build schedule, ensuring the right boards are ready in the right quantities at the right time for downstream assembly. Continuously reconcile the PCBA plan against the box-build plan as demand, engineering changes, or supply constraints shift, keeping both plans synchronized. Plan and track work-in-process (WIP) buffers, safety stock, and kit completeness to avoid starving or overloading assembly lines. Support new product introduction (NPI) and engineering change order (ECO) transitions by planning cut-in points, phase-out of legacy boards, and material disposition. 3. Efficiency, Loss Reduction & Cross-Functional Alignment Identify and drive opportunities to improve planning efficiency, reduce excess/obsolete (E&O) inventory, minimize scrap, and lower carrying costs across the PCBA portfolio. Monitor and report key planning metrics: schedule adherence, line utilization, component fill rate, shortage aging, inventory turns, and E&O exposure. Participate in daily/weekly production and S&OP (sales & operations planning) meetings, representing the PCBA plan and flagging risks to overall production targets. Partner with manufacturing engineering, quality, and test teams to align capacity plans with real line performance and yield. Maintain accurate planning data in the ERP/MRP system (BOMs, routings, lead times, lot sizes) and drive continuous improvement of planning parameters. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field (equivalent experience considered). 10+ years of experience in production/materials planning, supply chain, or manufacturing operations within an electronics or PCBA/EMS manufacturing environment. Demonstrated experience planning across a large, mixed portfolio of part numbers/products (high-mix, variable-volume environment). Working knowledge of electronic components, BOM structures, and SMT/PCBA manufacturing processes (SMT, THT, reflow, AOI, ICT/functional test). Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Infor, or similar) for demand planning, material requirements, and scheduling. Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, lookups, data analysis); experience with planning/BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with proven attention to detail and accuracy in high-volume data environments. Preferred / Desired Skills Experience planning in both high-volume/low-mix and low-volume/high-mix (or high-complexity) manufacturing environments simultaneously. Familiarity with S&OP, capacity planning, and finite/constraint-based scheduling concepts. Exposure to supplier management, component obsolescence management, and second-sourcing strategies. Understanding of Lean/Six Sigma or continuous-improvement methodologies applied to planning and inventory efficiency. APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent is a plus. Experience supporting NPI programs and coordinating with engineering during design/BOM transitions. Key Competencies Detail-oriented and highly organized — able to manage complex, high-SKU planning without losing accuracy. Systems thinker — able to connect component-level constraints to PCBA schedules to the overall box-build/system plan. Strong cross-functional communicator — comfortable coordinating daily with supply chain, procurement, manufacturing, and engineering. Proactive and data-driven — anticipates risk rather than reacting to it, and backs decisions with data. Resilient under ambiguity — comfortable re-planning quickly as components, demand, or engineering changes shift. Success Metrics (Illustrative) On-time PCBA availability to meet box-build/system production schedule. Component shortage incidents and average shortage-to-resolution time. SMT/PCBA line utilization and changeover efficiency. Inventory turns and excess & obsolete (E&O) inventory levels. Forecast/plan accuracy at the PCBA and component level.

Efficiency, Loss Reduction & Cross-Functional Alignment Identify and drive opportunities to improve planning efficiency, reduce excess/obsolete (E&O) inventory, minimize scrap, and lower carrying costs across the PCBA portfolio. Monitor and report key planning metrics: schedule adherence, line utilization, component fill rate, shortage aging, inventory turns, and E&O exposure. Partner with manufacturing engineering, quality, and test teams to align capacity plans with real line performance and yield. Maintain accurate planning data in the ERP/MRP system (BOMs, routings, lead times, lot sizes) and drive continuous improvement of planning parameters. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelors degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field (equivalent experience considered). 10+ years of experience in production/materials planning, supply chain, or manufacturing operations within an electronics or PCBA/EMS manufacturing environment. Working knowledge of electronic components, BOM structures, and SMT/PCBA manufacturing processes (SMT, THT, reflow, AOI, ICT/functional test). Preferred / Desired Skills Experience planning in both high-volume/low-mix and low-volume/high-mix (or high-complexity) manufacturing environments simultaneously. Experience supporting NPI programs and coordinating with engineering during design/BOM transitions. Key Competencies Detail-oriented and highly organized able to manage complex, high-SKU planning without losing accuracy. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. Identify discrepancies, investigate data gaps and establish robust data quality processes. 3. Develop analytical models for customer segmentation, retention, propensity, churn and customer lifetime value. Identify opportunities to improve campaign targeting, engagement and overall performance. 4. Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations rather than limiting outputs to dashboards and reports. Create industry benchmark reports and analytical inputs to support Business Development and Client Servicing teams. Identify potential upselling opportunities and new business opportunities through data-driven insights. 5. Predictive Analytics, Forecasting & AI Apply statistical techniques, predictive analytics and forecasting to identify trends and anticipate business outcomes. Develop models to support campaign uplift, customer behaviour analysis, performance optimisation and business planning. Explore and implement practical AI and machine learning applications to unlock value from existing datasets. Identify opportunities to automate analytical workflows and improve the efficiency and quality of insight generation. 6. Client & Stakeholder Management Present analytical findings, insights and recommendations confidently to clients and internal stakeholders. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, commercially relevant business narratives. Confidently explain and defend recommendations using data, evidence and business rationale. Work closely with Business Development, Client Servicing and internal teams to understand business requirements. Ensure analytical recommendations are relevant, accurate and aligned with client expectations. 7. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement Deliver regular actionable insight reports to internal teams and clients. Drive campaign performance improvement initiatives through data-led recommendations. Monitor campaign KPIs, engagement, participation, conversion and ROI. Continuously improve analytical processes, measurement standards and reporting accuracy. Ensure insights are implemented and their business impact is tracked. KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) Percentage of campaigns with actionable insights identified and implemented. Average uplift in engagement and participation resulting from analytical recommendations. Improvement in campaign performance, conversion and ROI. Number of upsell opportunities and business opportunities generated through data-led insights. Accuracy, consistency and reliability of consolidated data and analytical outputs. Timeliness and quality of actionable insight reports. Adoption and utilisation of analytical recommendations by internal teams and clients. Internal stakeholder satisfaction across Business Development, Client Servicing and other teams. Client feedback on the quality, relevance and commercial value of insights. Successful establishment and adoption of standardised analytics frameworks and processes. Key Skills & Experience 6+ years of relevant experience in Analytics, Business Analytics, Consumer Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics or related areas. Strong hands-on experience in consolidating multiple data sources, building data models and performing end-to-end analysis. Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel and Python for data extraction, manipulation and analysis. Proficiency in data visualisation and BI tools such as Power BI, GA4, Metabase, Looker or Tableau. Strong understanding of statistical analysis, predictive modelling, forecasting and machine learning techniques. Practical exposure to AI-driven analytics, automation or machine learning applications. Ability to interpret behavioural, performance and funnel data and derive meaningful insights. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate numbers into actionable business recommendations. Excellent data accuracy, reconciliation, validation and quality assurance capabilities. Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to present and defend insights. Ability to work independently, demonstrate resourcefulness and take complete ownership in a lean, entrepreneurial environment. title: Data Engineer

Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with extensive experience in enterprise data platform architecture, distributed systems, and technical leadership/anchor roles. Data Architecture & Processing: Expert mastery of Python, distributed computing with Spark on Cloud Dataproc, and advanced BigQuery data modeling, query optimization, and cost management. Programming & Systems Design: Expert mastery of Python, Java, or Scala for distributed computing, real-time streaming, and complex data pipeline creation. CI/CD & Security Frameworks: Comprehensive experience integrating Tekton, GitHub, SonarQube, Checkmarx, and FOSSA into automated release gates. Deep knowledge of enterprise GCP security (IAM, Secret Manager) and audit architectures (Cloud Run, Cloud Storage). Data Governance & Security Frameworks: Deep experience building data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and security infrastructure within GCP (VPC SC, IAM, KMS). Engineering Metrics & Quality Control: Proven experience embedding SWE-centric operational metrics (DORA metrics, code coverage, cyclomatic complexity, latency optimization) into platform operations. Executive Leadership & Influence: Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of influencing cross-team strategies, mentoring engineering talent, driving platform health initiatives, and resolving complex technical blockers.

title: IT Head
description: Role Overview We are seeking a seasoned, strategic Head of IT to lead the technology architecture, digital transformation, and operational resilience across our diverse business verticals: Media Production Studios, Commercial Malls, and Multiplex/Theater Operations . The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of enterprise IT infrastructure management, high-performance media/post-production workflow expertise, and smart-building/retail IT operations (POS, building management integration, high-density public Wi-Fi, and digital cinema/exhibition technologies). You will drive operational excellence, enforce robust cybersecurity frameworks, and align technology investments with organizational growth. Key Responsibilities 1. Enterprise & Smart Infrastructure Management (Malls & Corporate) · Oversee the end-to-end enterprise IT infrastructure, including data centers, server farms, enterprise storage, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and hybrid cloud environments (AWS/Azure). · Manage mission-critical IT systems for commercial mall operations, ensuring high availability of Building Management Systems (BMS), Public Address (PA) systems, CCTV/surveillance networks, and automated access controls. · Architect and maintain high-density public Wi-Fi networks, structured cabling, and robust switching/routing backbones (L2/L3) across retail and office spaces. · Oversee disaster recovery (DR) planning, business continuity drills, and power redundancy systems (UPS/Generators) for 24/7 retail and entertainment environments. 2. Multiplex, Cinema & Digital Exhibition Technology · Oversee IT and networking infrastructure supporting digital cinema projection systems, server ingestion, and Theatre Management Systems (TMS). · Manage automated scheduling, digital signage, box office ticketing kiosks, and secure content delivery (KDM/DCP management) in coordination with content distributors. · Ensure ultra-low latency and absolute uptime for live-streaming, event screenings, and concessionaire point-of-sale (POS) networks. 3. Post-Production & Media Studio Technology · Support high-performance media workflows including non-linear editing (Avid, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), VFX, animation, sound design, and heavy rendering farms. · Administer high-speed SAN/NAS environments optimized for uncompressed 4K/8K real-time collaboration. · Manage Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, secure ingest/transcoding pipelines, and long-term digital archiving/retrieval processes. 4. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations · Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises. · Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines. 5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy · Establish enterprise-wide cybersecurity policies, endpoint protection, Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), and SIEM tools. · Protect high-value intellectual property (IP), unreleased media assets, and confidential tenant/customer data in compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., DPDP Act, PCI-DSS for retail transactions). · Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and IT security audits. 6. Vendor, Project & Budget Management · Lead strategic technology implementation projects, digital upgrades, and capital expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) planning. · Manage relationships with global technology vendors, telecom operators, OEM partners, and service providers. · Negotiate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), software licensing, and hardware procurement to optimize costs without compromising quality. 7. Leadership & Cross-Functional Team Management · Lead, mentor, and upskill a multi-disciplinary team of IT engineers, system administrators, and helpdesk support staff. · Define and monitor strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution and system performance. · Act as a technology advisor to executive leadership, bridging the gap between creative teams, retail management, and technical execution. Core Enterprise & Network Infrastructure · Advanced administration of Windows Server, Linux, and macOS enterprise environments. · Enterprise networking: Cisco/Aruba L2/L3 switching, VLAN segmentation, SD-WAN, enterprise firewalls, and QoS configuration. · Virtualization & Cloud: VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud integration. · Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) frameworks. · Advanced backup frameworks (Veeam, Commvault) and Disaster Recovery architecture. Domain-Specific Expertise · Retail & Mall Tech: POS infrastructure, payment gateway security (PCI-DSS), digital signage networks, and smart building integration (BMS/CCTV). · Theater/Exhibition Tech: Theatre Management Systems (TMS), digital projection networks, and ticketing system integration. · Media / Post-Production: High-speed SAN/NAS (Avid ISIS/Nexus, Isilon, QNAP), render management (Deadline, OpenCue), and MAM workflows. Educational Qualifications & Credentials · Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field. Master’s degree / MBA is a plus. title: Senior Data QA Engineer
description: Job Description We are looking for a Senior Data QE Engineer with solid experience in ETL testing and data validation, and strong SQL skills. You will design and run data quality tests, validate pipelines end to end, reconcile source and analytical data, and give engineering and business teams evidence for release decisions. Qualifications Senior-level data quality engineering experience in ETL testing and data validation. Strong SQL and Snowflake data-modelling experience, including layered raw, history, silver, and gold models, reconciliation and drift queries, and slowly changing dimensions and merge behavior. Experience with logical and physical data models and with assessing the downstream impact of schema and data-contract changes. Experience validating PostgreSQL sources, including consistent snapshot counts and logical replication. Hands-on Python automation for data comparison and reconciliation, using pytest or an equivalent framework. Experience running and reading orchestrated pipelines in Airflow or an equivalent scheduler. Experience validating data movement, transformation, completeness, history, freshness, and compliance from source systems into analytical datasets.

title: Senior Microsoft Fabric Data Architect
description: Senior Microsoft Fabric Data Architect to design and build data platform for high-performance analytics at scale: fast self-service and ad-hoc queries over large data sets, and a foundation ready for AI. Build ELT and CDC pipelines from SQL Server and other sources without impacting operational systems. Set standards for security, governance, and CI/CD; review and mentor engineers. What you bring 7+ years in data, 5+ as an architect, with 2+ enterprise data warehouses delivered end to end. Production Microsoft Fabric experience. Expert SQL Server / T-SQL and PySpark or Spark SQL. Dimensional modeling (Kimball), medallion architecture, and performance design at scale. Proven BA skills: turning business needs into data models and KPIs. Experience preparing data for AI. A track record of shipping on tight timelines, independently.
